bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” are allowed in the venue. All bags will be searched prior to entry, and non-clear bags will undergo additional search.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: The Wiltern offers premium underground parking and upgrades for select shows. The most convenient parking option is the Ralphs parking structure adjacent to the venue, accessible from Oxford Street through the north entrance.

rideshare.note: Drop off members of your party at the main entrance.

concessions.note: The Wiltern offers a variety of concession items including popcorn, chips, pizza, churros, and nachos, along with alcoholic and nonalcoholic beverages. The venue is cashless, accepting major credit cards and ApplePay.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Limited storage is available for wheelchairs, canes, walkers, and other mobility devices.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: There is no re-entry once your ticket is scanned, so bring everything you need for the show. If your service animal needs a relief area, guest services can help you exit and re-enter.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office and Will Call open two hours before doors on show days only. Bring photo ID and the card used to buy. All events are mobile entry, tickets aren't emailed or printable, and the box office can help with phone trouble on event day.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The accessible restroom is located on the main level to the right of the main entrance as you enter.
